description.value: Banh Mi Bar is a Vietnamese restaurant on Carnarvon Street in downtown New Westminster, serving banh mi and related fare in a smoke-free, indoor-seating setting. It caters to vegetarians, making it a useful stop for plant-based touring cyclists passing through the Royal City. New Westminster's compact downtown is a natural rest point for riders on the Central Valley Greenway or connecting routes along the Fraser River.
